name: daily-bread-statusbar
displayName: Daily Bible — Offline & Scripture Status Bar
description: 100% Offline Holy Bible (isiZulu 1959, English WEB & KJV) with glanceable status bar scriptures, parallel dual-reader, bookmarks, and curated mood themes.

commands.title: Daily Bible: Open Scripture Quick Action Menu
Daily Bible: Read Full Chapter in In-Editor Reader
Daily Bible: Select Topic / Mood Filter
Daily Bible: Switch Translation (isiZulu / WEB / KJV)
Daily Bible: Search & Jump to Scripture Reference
Daily Bible: Copy Current Verse to Clipboard
Daily Bible: Change Reader Font Size
Daily Bible: Change Reader Font Family
Daily Bible: Change Rotation Schedule Frequency

enumDescriptions: English — King James Version / Bible (KJV / KJB - classic traditional poetic English)
English — World English Bible (Clean modern public domain English)
isiZulu — IBhayibheli Elingcwele (1959 Translation)
dailyBread.translation.description: Primary Bible translation to display in the status bar and reader (Default: English KJB).

enumDescriptions: Disabled (single translation)
Show isiZulu translation alongside primary in hover tooltip & parallel reader
Show WEB translation alongside primary in hover tooltip & parallel reader
Show KJV translation alongside primary in hover tooltip & parallel reader
dailyBread.dualTranslation.description: Secondary parallel translation for dual side-by-side reading.

enumDescriptions: Reference only (e.g. ✝ AmaHubo 23:1 or ✝ Psalm 23:1)
Reference and quote preview (e.g. ✝ Phil 4:13 — "Nginamandla...")
Full complete verse text
Latin Cross (✝)
Open Book (📖)
Peace Dove (🕊️)
No icon
dailyBread.icon.description: Icon symbol prefix in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Manual only (change via shortcut Ctrl+Alt+B or menu)
Rotate every 5 minutes
Rotate every 15 minutes (recommended)
Rotate every 30 minutes
Rotate every 60 minutes
Rotate every time an active editor tab is opened
dailyBread.rotationSchedule.description: Schedule frequency for rotating status bar scripture.

dailyBread.rotateOnFileSave.description: When enabled, automatically rotates to a fresh encouraging verse whenever you save a file.

dailyBread.preventRotationWhileReading.description: Prevents the status bar scripture from auto-changing while you are reading. Any rotation that becomes due while reading will wait until you resume interacting with the editor.

enumDescriptions: All Scripture — cycles through all curated themes and scriptures
Peace & Rest (Ukuthula Nokuphumula) — calm and anxiety relief
Focus & Wisdom (Ukuhlakanipha Nokugxila) — clarity while coding
Strength & Courage (Amandla Nesibindi) — stamina and perseverance
Hard Times & Comfort (Izikhathi Ezinzima Nenduduzo) — solace in struggle
Gratitude & Praise (Ukubonga Nokudumisa) — thanksgiving and joy
Joy & Hope (Injabulo Nethemba) — uplifting encouragement
dailyBread.topic.description: Active scripture topic/mood filter for status bar rotation.

dailyBread.fontSize.description: Scripture font size in pixels (Reader View & Reading tabs). Set to 0 to automatically match your active VS Code editor font size (editor.fontSize).

enumDescriptions: Match your active VS Code editor font family (editor.fontFamily)
Book serif (Georgia, Garamond, Palatino, serif)
Modern clean sans-serif (Segoe UI, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif)
Monospace code font (Consolas, monospace)
System UI font (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI)
dailyBread.fontFamily.description: Font family for the Bible Reader. Default: Match active VS Code editor font.
